notes: Material request processing (same tables as ST_ITEM_REQ, open requests only): same save rules (APP_RULES_SA); actions TO_TRANSFER_REQ / TO_PURCHASE_REQ = legacy REQUEST_TRANSFER / REQUEST_ORDER (APP_CONV); outstanding-PO warning, delete refused when converted, item count / project reference (APP_ACT_ST)

ST_ITEM_REQ_DET.ITEM_NAME.sql: (select max(nvl(i.name_e, i.name_a)) from st_item i where i.item_group_code = t.group_code and i.item_code = t.item_code)

ST_ITEM_REQ_DET.TO_STORE_BAL.sql: case when (nvl(to_number(v('G_USER_CODE')), 0) = 0 or (select nvl(max(u.allow_view_balance), 0) from users u where u.users_code = to_number(v('G_USER_CODE'))) = 1) then round(nvl(get_balance((select r.store_code from st_item_req r where r.trns_type_code = t.trns_type_code and r.trns_serial = t.trns_serial), t.group_code, t.item_code), 0) / nvl((select max(u.factor) from st_item_unit u where u.group_code = t.group_code and u.item_code = t.item_code and u.unit_code = t.unit_code), 1), 3) end

ST_ITEM_REQ_DET.FROM_STORE_BAL.sql: case when (nvl(to_number(v('G_USER_CODE')), 0) = 0 or (select nvl(max(u.allow_view_balance), 0) from users u where u.users_code = to_number(v('G_USER_CODE'))) = 1) then round(nvl(get_balance((select r.from_store_code from st_item_req r where r.trns_type_code = t.trns_type_code and r.trns_serial = t.trns_serial), t.group_code, t.item_code), 0) / nvl((select max(u.factor) from st_item_unit u where u.group_code = t.group_code and u.item_code = t.item_code and u.unit_code = t.unit_code), 1), 3) end

rules.where: TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT T.TRNS_TYPE_CODE FROM ST_TRNS_TYPE T WHERE T.EFFECT = 7 AND T.TRNS_TYPE = 12 AND T.STORE_CODE IS NOT NULL) AND (NVL(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER,0) = 0 OR TRNS_TYPE_CODE IN (SELECT TP.TRNS_TYPE_CODE FROM ST_TRNSTYPE_PASSWORD TP WHERE TP.PASSWORD_NUMBER = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) AND (TRNS_TYPE_CODE, TRNS_SERIAL) IN (SELECT D.TRNS_TYPE_CODE, D.TRNS_SERIAL FROM ST_ITEM_REQ_DET D WHERE NVL(D.PR_FLAG,0) = 0)

params.name: TARGET_TYPE
params.lov_sql: select t.trns_type_code || ' - ' || decode(:G_LANG, 'en', t.desc_e, t.desc_a) d, t.trns_type_code r from st_trns_type t where t.effect = 7 and t.trns_type = 9 and t.store_code is not null and ((select min(nvl(b.rltd_trns_str_flag, 1)) from st_basic b) = 0 or t.store_code = :PAGE_FROM_STORE_CODE) and (nvl(:G_PASSWORD_NUMBER, 0) = 0 or t.trns_type_code in (select tp.trns_type_code from st_trnstype_password tp where tp.password_number = :G_PASSWORD_NUMBER)) order by t.trns_type_code
